description: Dashboard contract for the historical and IoT Gold datasets.
dashboard_views: Historical monthly climate and price summary
IoT sensor monthly conditions and nutrient summary

requires: QuickSight subscription in the AWS account
Athena and Glue permissions for the QuickSight service role
validation: Confirm both datasets can query their Athena tables
Apply YEAR/MM filters and verify partition pruning
Create dashboard visuals from the declared dimensions and measures
